title: The VLT images a "rectangular" planetary nebula
caption: The planetary nebula IC 4406, imaged by ESO's Very Large Telescope
celestial: IC 4406 · constellation Lupus · about 5000 light-years away (source figure)

recognition.text: Official ESO press-release image. No published audience rating.

story: This nebula has an unusual, almost rectangular outline. It is IC 4406, a planetary nebula in the southern constellation Lupus, the Wolf, at a distance that is uncertain but possibly about 5,000 light-years.

A planetary nebula is the shell of gas a Sun-like star throws off late in its life. IC 4406 belongs to the bipolar kind, where material streams out in two opposite directions. Other bipolar nebulae, such as the Butterfly Nebula, show a prominent dark band of dust across the middle. In IC 4406 that dusty band is weaker, and the inside of the nebula looks more even.

The colors carry information. Different parts of the nebula glow in different hues because they differ in what they are made of and in their physical conditions. This picture was taken with the Very Large Telescope's Test Camera, and the frames were combined without further processing beyond basic cleaning.
scale: Using the source's listed field of view (1.43 x 1.51 arcminutes) and distance (5000 light years), the frame spans roughly 2.1 × 2.2 light-years. Its light set out about 5,000 years before reaching the telescope.

understand.summary: The VLT Test Camera took this visible-light image through B, V and R filters. The color assigned to each filter isn't published.
understand.eye: The camera gathered light over several minutes, recording a faint nebula in far more color and detail than an eye could see.

behind.exposure: Not published on the source page.
behind.technique: Not stated by the source (single frame, stack, mosaic or panorama unknown).

explore: The image combines short blue, green-yellow and red exposures of a few minutes each. The field shown is 1.5 by 1.5 arcminutes, with north to the upper right and east to the upper left.
alt: A planetary nebula with an almost rectangular outline, showing regions of different colors.
